$Comment: The in-game screen for the XP price table, on the owner menu (/zigadmin): one row per price (a quest, a board job, a dungeon clear, an achievement), each opening how many minutes of play it pays and the level those minutes are priced at, saved straight into mods/ziggfreedcommon/track-prices.json under that price's id, beside the value it has without your file. An owner may add a price of their own by a new id and remove one only their file holds. Every word is a key of ziggfreedcommon.track.lang. Retune this screen (its place on the menu, a bound) in mods/ziggfreedcommon/owner-forms.json under the id Track_Prices.
Title: ziggfreedcommon.track.form.prices.title
